preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'staging'

changeSet.comment: DROP the staging landing schema and its seven tables — the RDR-180 land-then-transform landing zone, retired with the /v1/staging routes (RDR-223 Phase 3 step 2, nexus-z0o2p.27). DATA EFFECT: DROPs staging.chunks, staging.document_chunks, staging.topic_assignments, staging.frecency, staging.relevance_log, staging.document_aspects and staging.aspect_extraction_queue, discarding any landed rows; irreversible for the data (the rollback restores the empty structure only: the rows were a landing area, and no code reads them once the routes are gone).
changeSet.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS staging.chunks, staging.document_chunks, staging.topic_assignments, staging.frecency, staging.relevance_log, staging.document_aspects, staging.aspect_extraction_queue; DROP SCHEMA staging;
